segments.activity: Read the opening only and record a prediction/question
Model a clue, prediction and unresolved question
Reveal the ending and compare predictions
Write a summary and a useful question
Revise a claim with textual evidence

support: Read each paragraph aloud without revealing the ending early. Offer separate problem/action/result boxes and let a pupil dictate while directing the wording. Ask which sentence supports each claim; do not supply the independent answer.
extension: Compare two plausible predictions from the opening, explain why later evidence supports one more strongly and propose a new observation that could change the recommendation.
block90Proposal: After the 45-minute core, compare two different faithful summaries for 15 minutes, write a short alternative ending and trace which predictions it changes for 15 minutes, then peer-review and revise for 15 minutes. This is a proposed extension, not measured timing.
assessment: No governed assessment or official score is supplied. All questions are ungraded practice; future independent assessment remains a separate request.
offline: Print the opening and ending on separate sheets. Keep the ending covered until after prediction. Read passages and options aloud as needed; pupils select evidence or dictate responses on paper. No audio asset or device voice is promised.
retention: Request a different short narrative after at least seven days, with the same predict/question/summarize strategy. No event is scheduled here.
